'''Orpali dragons''' were a rare [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] that was considered a delicacy by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Orpali dragons were bred and grown in captivity, [[Death/Legends|killed]] in infancy, and then traditionally served on a bed of glazed [[Gorg/Legends|chuba]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. At least a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] orpali dragons were on the menu for the [[Bakuush's centennial feast|centennial feast]] of [[Bakuush]] the Hutt, but several dragon hatchlings escaped from [[Bakuush's palace]] through the sewers into the toxic [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where they eventually evolved into [[chemilizard]]s.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orpali dragons were first mentioned in the Codex entry for chemilizards in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
